about: MIDI Loopback 1.6 for Digitakt OS 1.53 and 1.54: the author's released .elemod files, pinned unchanged, with needs_core 4.1 as its README states.

mods.title: MIDI Loopback
mods.summary: Software MIDI loopback cable for Digitakt mk1: MIDI tracks 9â€“16 feed audio tracks 1â€“8 and Master FX internally via CCs, p-locks, notes and the MIDI LFO; the FLTR page's CC labels are renamed to the internal parameter names, and it switches on/off in SETTINGS > MIDI LOOPBACK.
mods.description: Internal MIDI loopback: sequences and modulates audio tracks 1-8 and Master FX from MIDI tracks 9-16 using parameter locks, CCs, note triggers, and LFOs without external cables. Toggle ON/OFF in SETTINGS > MIDI LOOPBACK. Displays Digitakt parameter names on MIDI tracks' FLTR CC Select page.
mods.on_unit: Tested on a unit. The one I'm using currently is version 1.6.
